build.label: Build
build.name: Build
build.tip: Building is like cooking dinner. Engineers are your best cooks.

testing.label: Test
testing.name: Test & inspect
testing.tip: Testing is tasting the soup before you serve it. Inspectors do it best.

training.label: Train
training.name: Train crew
training.tip: Training is practice laps for the crew. Anyone can run the drills.

fundraise.label: Funds
fundraise.name: Fundraise
fundraise.tip: Fundraising brings in money. A PR lead is the best at asking.

rest.label: Rest
rest.name: Rest
rest.tip: Rest lifts morale. A happy team gets more done every week.

text.crewTip: On a road trip you want someone who can fix a flat and someone who stays calm. Space is the same. Training helps too.

weekHints.1: Week 1, Design: start building. Keep one person on Test so no week goes untested.
weekHints.2: Week 2, Parts: keep building and keep testing. Flaws are cheapest to fix early.
weekHints.3: Week 3, Assembly: Build should be past halfway. Start training the crew.
weekHints.4: Week 4, Testing: push Testing to 60 or more, or expect a No-Go vote at launch.
weekHints.5: Week 5, Rollout: Build must reach 100 to launch. Then train, or rest a tired team.

text.crunchWarn: {left}, and we are not done yet. We are running out of time.
text.crunchAsk: Do you want to hold a crunch week? Everything costs more this week, but your progress goes up faster.
text.crunchYesLine: Long days and a lot of coffee, then. Let's make this week count.
text.crunchNoLine: Steady it is. We do what we can with the time we have.
